title: Days Gone
provenance: Reported by Clemens00505 (highball-db#1139, 2026-11-10), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r30, DXMT, rated 3 of 5 after 12 minutes: into the open world at 60 fps locked by the Metal HUD at 1728x1117, render scale 80% and a 60 fps cap, with occasional minor stutter. Without a workaround it freezes on a still frame at start, with the sound and then the menu sounds playing but the picture never changing. Moving the four intro videos out of BendGame/Content/Movies (ps_studios.mp4, bend_studio.mp4, sie_presents.mp4 and Climax_2024_Ident_wAudio.mp4, logos only) gets past it. The reporter reads the cause in the log as Wine's GStreamer failing to play these H.264 videos (a gst_caps_is_fixed assertion). WINE_DO_NOT_CREATE_DXGI_DEVICE_MANAGER=1 was set while testing, not known to be needed. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Plays on an M5 Pro with DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r30 at 60 fps once the four intro videos are moved out of BendGame/Content/Movies (highball-db#1139). Steam's Verify files and game updates put them back. Untested here: disabling Media Foundation (mfplat) for DaysGone.exe made other Unreal games skip their videos (Fort Solis), and a DLL override is something a recipe can set. The game has no FSR or DLSS, render scale 80% with a 60 fps cap works best on a 120 Hz display.

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes on a still frame at start, with sound playing but the picture never changing (M5 Pro, Wine 11 r30, DXMT)
knownIssues.cause: by the reporter's reading of the log, Wine's GStreamer can't play the four H.264 intro videos (gst_caps_is_fixed assertion). Not measured here
knownIssues.fix: move ps_studios.mp4, bend_studio.mp4, sie_presents.mp4 and Climax_2024_Ident_wAudio.mp4 out of Days Gone/BendGame/Content/Movies. They are logo intros only, and Verify files or an update puts them back (highball-db#1139, credit Clemens00505)

knownIssues.symptom: Occasional minor stutter at a 60 fps cap (M5 Pro, Wine 11 r30, DXMT)
